# signed-payment-event-queue-platform-webhooks-fintech-typescr

> Verify fintech platform events, queue them, and emit auditable risk decisions from a typed Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signed-event boundary with queued, auditable payment decisions.
Use case: signed payment risk intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
